zh.consent.title: 翻译前请确认
zh.consent.body1: 开启中英对照阅读需要把
zh.consent.body2: 发送到外部翻译服务（uapis.cn AI 翻译接口）。
zh.consent.li1: 上传内容仅限你所浏览的技能文档正文；
zh.consent.li2: 该服务按次计积分（当前 4 积分/次），内容未变的文档会被缓存、不会重复调用；
zh.consent.li3: 代码块、命令、路径、环境变量会先摘出再翻译，不会被改写；
zh.consent.li5: 切换语言后，技能概述、分类标签与仓库简介也会按目标语言翻译并缓存；
zh.consent.li4: 可随时在右上角 ⓘ 中查看本提示、撤回同意或重新开启。
zh.revoke.title: 撤回翻译同意？
zh.revoke.body: 撤回后将不再发起新的翻译请求；本地已缓存的译文仍可查看，随时可在右上角 ⓘ 重新开启。
zh.unknown.title: 移入「自由技能」？
zh.unknown.after: 个技能的仓库归属清除为自由技能；归属错误也随时可在「整理归属」中重新归组。
zh.snooze.title: 暂不处理这些推断？
zh.snooze.after: 个待确认推断的技能移入「自由技能」，后续不再对它们自动推断归类；之后仍可随时手动归组。

zh.info.title: 状态与隐私说明
zh.info.privacyText: 开启翻译后，新翻译的文档原文会发送到外部服务 uapis.cn（AI 翻译接口）；已缓存译文只在本地读取。切换语言时，技能概述、分类标签与仓库简介也会翻译并缓存。代码块/命令/路径/环境变量会先摘出、译后回填，不会被翻译改写。
zh.info.creditsText: 累计 {credits} 积分 · {calls} 次调用（每次 4 积分）
zh.info.apiKeyText: 网页 ⚙ 设置页保存的密钥以 OS 凭据库 + AES-256-GCM 加密落盘；密钥永不回传浏览器明文。

zh.error.probe_failed: 服务可达性探针未通过。

en.topbar.searchPlaceholder: Search name / description / category / repo…  Ctrl+K
en.topbar.updateTitle: Rescan and analyze (incremental; unchanged content makes no API calls; batch pre-translation of entry documents happens here)

en.topbar.languageTitle: Interface language (also sets the translation target)

en.badge.forkTitle: Same-name skills with diverged content are shown as separate versions

en.viewer.retryingBanner: Retrying failed blocks… (4 credits per call; unchanged content is cached; long documents are chunked and may take tens of seconds)
en.viewer.consentNeeded: Bilingual reading requires accepting the privacy notice first.

en.viewer.consentPaused: New translation requests are paused; cached translations remain available.

en.toast.updateStarted: Re-analysis started (incremental: unchanged content makes no API calls)
en.toast.confirmFirst: Select the skills to confirm first
en.toast.revoked: Consent revoked; no new translation requests will be sent
en.toast.savedAnalyzing: Saved; running an incremental analysis with the new settings…
en.consent.title: Before translating
en.consent.body2: to an external translation service (uapis.cn AI translation API).
en.consent.li1: Only the body of the skill document you are viewing is sent;
en.consent.li2: The service charges credits per call (currently 4 credits); unchanged documents are cached and not re-sent;
en.consent.li3: Code blocks, commands, paths and environment variables are extracted before translation and never rewritten;
en.consent.li5: After switching languages, skill summaries, category tags and repository blurbs are also translated into the target language and cached;
en.consent.li4: You can review this notice, revoke consent, or re-enable it anytime under ⓘ in the top-right corner.
en.revoke.title: Revoke translation consent?
en.revoke.body: After revoking, no new translation requests will be sent; locally cached translations remain available, and you can re-enable it anytime under ⓘ.
en.unknown.title: Move to “Standalone skills”?
en.unknown.before: This will clear the repository attribution of the selected
en.unknown.after: skills to standalone; you can re-group them anytime in Organize.
en.snooze.title: Skip these inferences?
en.snooze.after: skills with pending inferences to “Standalone skills” and stop inferring their origin automatically; you can still group them manually anytime.
en.toast.snoozed: Moved to standalone; automatic inference skipped from now on

en.settings.testFullTitle: Sends a 1-character real translation for a definitive result

en.info.title: Status and privacy
en.info.privacyText: After translation is enabled, newly translated document text is sent to the external uapis.cn AI translation API; cached translations are read locally only. When you switch languages, skill summaries, category tags and repository blurbs are also translated and cached. Code blocks, commands, paths and environment variables are extracted first and restored afterwards, never rewritten.
en.info.apiKeyText: Keys saved from ⚙ Settings are encrypted to disk with the OS credential store + AES-256-GCM; full keys are never sent back to the browser.
en.error.consent_required: Accept the privacy notice before translating.
